summary: Korn Ferry filed an 8-K reporting entry into an amended and restated credit agreement with Wells Fargo as administrative agent. The agreement provides a $600 million senior secured term loan facility and continues an $850 million revolving credit facility, both maturing five years from August 18, 2026. Borrowings are secured by substantially all assets. Proceeds fund the redemption of existing obligations, pay fees, and finance a portion of the purchase price for its previously announced pending acquisition of AMS. Interest is based on Term SOFR or base rate plus leverage-based margins. Watch for regulatory approvals and closing conditions for the AMS acquisition.
